'''Jani-King International, Inc.''' is an American chain of commercial [[cleaner|cleaning]] services [[franchising|franchise]]s. The company provides janitorial services and commercial cleaning services for public spaces such as offices, retails spaces, [[hotel]]s, and [[stadium]]s.

==History==
The company was founded by James Cavanaugh, Jr., in 1969. In 2001, it was the title sponsor of the [[NASCAR]] event at the [[Texas Motor Speedway]] now known as the [[NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series at Texas Motor Speedway|SRS Distribution 250]]. In 2002, Cavanaugh was involved in a scandal when his girlfriend, Claire Robinson, died of a cocaine overdose while on vacation with him at his Caribbean holiday home. In 2019, a court found that a settlement payment of $2.3 million he had made to avoid negative publicity for the company and liability arising from Robinson's death was not a deductible business expense for his S corporation.<ref>{{cite book|url=http://www.ca5.uscourts.gov/opinions/unpub/18/18-60299.0.pdf|title=Appeals from a Decision of the United States Tax Court T.C. No. 30825-09 T.C. No. 29194-11|publisher=United States Court of Appeals|access-date=June 27, 2023}}</ref>

==Current organization==
Jani-King's corporate offices are in [[Addison, Texas]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.janiking.com/contact-jani-king/|title=Contact Jani-King|work=Jani-King|access-date=2018-07-14|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Seid |first=Michael |date=October 19, 2016 |title=Franchisor Profile: Jerry Crawford, Jani-King |language=en |work=The Balance Small Business |url=http://franchises.about.com/od/franchiseinterviews/fl/Franchisor-Profile-Jerry-Crawford-Jani-King.htm |access-date=2018-07-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171209043935/https://www.thebalance.com/franchisor-profile-jerry-crawford-jani-king-1350594 |archive-date=Dec 9, 2017}}</ref>

From its corporate headquarters, and through regional support offices in local markets, Jani-King provides its franchise owners additional training and certification programs for servicing hotels and hospitals. In August 2012, Jani-King partnered with a sports team, the [[Buffalo Bills]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Buehler |first=Hannah |date=Aug 23, 2012 |title=Jani-King partners with Bills |work=Buffalo Bills |url=http://www.buffalobills.com/news/article-1/Jani-King-partners-with-Bills/d8a8edf2-4b9b-4ffd-b489-d312ff9ea0b3 |access-date=2018-05-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180517223300/http://www.buffalobills.com/news/article-1/Jani-King-partners-with-Bills/d8a8edf2-4b9b-4ffd-b489-d312ff9ea0b3 |archive-date=2018-05-17}}</ref>
